title: Neospector guide
introduction: Instructions for a first session and a reference for the main controls. The public-test documentation is being expanded.

sections.title: First session
sections.body:
1. Import video or images into the Library, or select a camera input.
2. Place sources into queue A or B.
3. Add an effect to the corresponding module rack and adjust it while watching the preview.
4. Select an audio input or file to drive audio-responsive effects.
5. Record the output once your sources and effects are ready.

sections.title: Sources and queues
sections.body: The Library holds imported media. Visual queues A and B control playback for their respective channels. A camera input can temporarily take over a channel.

sections.title: Effects and audio
sections.body: Add modules to the channel rack and adjust their controls. Use the Conductor to influence effect behaviour. Start with one effect at a time to see what each control changes.

sections.title: Recording
sections.body: Check the preview and output location before recording. Verify the recording on your own system before relying on it for a live performance.

sections.title: Installation and troubleshooting
sections.body: Choose the installer for your operating system. Linux uses a DEB package, Windows a setup EXE, and macOS a native PKG for Apple Silicon or Intel. Public-test installers may not be signed or notarised. If the preview is blank, confirm a source is loaded and the relevant channel is playing.
